examples.en: The busmen are going on strike next week.
examples.zh: 公共汽车司机们下星期要罢工。

examples.en: The busmen have decided to go on strike.
examples.zh: 公共汽车司机们决定罢工。

examples.en: The strike is due to begin on Tuesday.
The train is due to arrive at ten.
They have stated that the strike will continue.
examples.zh: 他们声明罢工会继续下去。

examples.en: The strike will continue for at least a week.
examples.zh: 罢工至少会持续一个星期。

examples.en: A general agreement has not been reached.
They reached an agreement about pay.
examples.zh: 他们就工资问题达成了协议。

examples.en: Many owners of private cars offer free rides.
examples.zh: 许多私家车主提供免费搭乘。

examples.en: He offered me a free ride to work.
This will relieve pressure on the trains.
The trains are under great pressure.

examples.zh: 这在某种程度上有所帮助。

examples.en: The students volunteered to drive buses.
examples.zh: 学生们自愿来开公共汽车。

examples.en: All the students are expert drivers.
examples.zh: 所有学生都是驾驶能手。

examples.en: They will have to pass a special test.
examples.zh: 他们必须通过一次专门考试。

examples.en: The students are going to take the test very soon.
examples.zh: 学生们很快就要参加考试。

sentences.en: Busmen have decided to go on strike next week.
sentences.zh: 公共汽车司机们决定下星期举行罢工。

sentences.en: The strike is due to begin on Tuesday.
No one knows how long it will last.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道罢工将持续多久。

sentences.en: The busmen have stated that the strike will continue until general agreement is reached about pay and working conditions.
sentences.zh: 司机们声明，在工资和工作条件方面达成全面协议之前，罢工将继续进行。

sentences.zh: 学生们很快就要参加考试。

article.en: Busmen have decided to go on strike next week.
article.zh: 公共汽车司机们决定下星期举行罢工。

article.en: The strike is due to begin on Tuesday.
No one knows how long it will last.
article.zh: 没有人知道罢工将持续多久。

article.en: The busmen have stated that the strike will continue until general agreement is reached about pay and working conditions.
article.zh: 司机们声明，在工资和工作条件方面达成全面协议之前，罢工将继续进行。

article.en: Most people believe that the strike will last for at least a week.
article.zh: 大多数人认为罢工至少会持续一个星期。

article.en: Many owners of private cars are going to offer free rides to people on their way to work.
article.zh: 许多私家车主将向上班的人们提供免费乘车。

article.en: This will relieve pressure on the trains to some extent.
article.zh: 这将在一定程度上减轻火车的压力。

article.en: Meanwhile, a number of university students have volunteered to drive buses while the strike lasts.
article.zh: 与此同时，一些大学生自愿在罢工期间驾驶公共汽车。

article.en: All the students are expert drivers, but before they drive any of the buses, they will have to pass a special test.
article.zh: 所有学生都是驾驶能手，但在驾驶任何公共汽车之前，他们必须通过一次专门考试。

article.en: The students are going to take the test very soon.
article.zh: 学生们很快就要参加考试。
